description: New Jersey Family Leave Insurance (ZP-TAX-US-2026-001 §13, test ID US-NJ-FLI-001) -- covered wages $10,000, below the $171,100 FLI wage base, employee rate 0.23%. Expected employee FLI $23.00. Only the FLI component is included here (not NJ's other three worker programs) to isolate this single component per the test ID's own scope.
source: ZP-TAX-US-2026-001 v1.0: Section 5 (NJ Family Leave Insurance: employee 0.23%, $171,100 wage base, $393.53 max), Section 13 test US-NJ-FLI-001, Appendix A ("DI/FLI $171,100. FLI max worker contribution $393.53"). Recomputed by running the real engine: 10000 * 0.23% = 23.00 (well under both the wage base and the annual max).
